our_interpretation: It refers to Claude Code using the 4.6 model generation.
The plain reading of AGI is broad human-level intellectual competence, including learning and transferring to unfamiliar tasks beyond coding.
Human-level competence does not require perfect accuracy. Coding mistakes alone cannot establish the absence of AGI.
Assess the referenced generation during February 2026 through April 12, 2026, rather than later model releases.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations of the referenced system establish substantial deficits relative to humans across representative unfamiliar tasks that bear directly on general intellectual competence.
